stories.headline: Trump orders naval blockade of Strait of Hormuz after failed Iran negotiations
stories.summary: After 20 hours of failed negotiations in Pakistan, President Trump announced the US would blockade the Strait of Hormuz and intercept ships that paid transit fees to Iran. Trump threatened that Iranian forces would be 'blown to hell' if they attacked US vessels, while Iran claimed control over the strait.
